/* ---------- Statutory rules (only those needed for this query) ---------- */

% Section 1(a) - tax table for married individuals filing jointly (and surviving spouses)

tax_married_joint(TI, Tax) :-                 % (i) 15% up to $36,900
    TI =< 36900,
    Tax is TI * 0.15.

tax_married_joint(TI, Tax) :-                 % (ii) $5,535 + 28% of excess over $36,900
    TI =< 89150,
    Tax is 5535 + 0.28 * (TI - 36900).

tax_married_joint(TI, Tax) :-                 % (iii) $20,165 + 31% of excess over $89,150
    TI =< 140000,
    Tax is 20165 + 0.31 * (TI - 89150).

tax_married_joint(TI, Tax) :-                 % (iv) $35,928.50 + 36% of excess over $140,000
    TI =< 250000,
    Tax is 35928.5 + 0.36 * (TI - 140000).

tax_married_joint(TI, Tax) :-                 % (v) $75,528.50 + 39.6% of excess over $250,000
    TI  > 250000,
    Tax is 75528.5 + 0.396 * (TI - 250000).

/* ---------- Auxiliary rules ---------- */

rounded_dollar(Amount, Rounded) :-            % IRS amounts are rounded to whole dollars
    Rounded is round(Amount).

% Total tax for a taxpayer who files a joint return with a spouse
taxpayer_tax(Person, RoundedTax) :-
    filing_status(Person, married_filing_jointly),
    taxable_income(Person, TI),
    tax_married_joint(TI, RawTax),
    rounded_dollar(RawTax, RoundedTax).

/* ---------- Facts drawn from the case ---------- */

person(alice).
married(alice).
joint_return_filed(alice).
taxable_income(alice, 42876).

filing_status(alice, married_filing_jointly) :-
    married(alice),
    joint_return_filed(alice).

/* ---------- Verification of the claim ---------- */

:- (  taxpayer_tax(alice, 7208)
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.
